_note: Newest first or any order, the site sorts by date. type is one of: new-player, transfer, promotion, demotion, announcement. image is a file name inside img/news/ (leave it out or missing to show the placeholder). The three entries below are examples.

text.en: raduTNT joins the main roster as our new Entry fragger. He arrives with years of experience and a very loud mouse click. Say hi on Discord and show him how we play in -20°C.
text.ro: raduTNT se alătură echipei principale ca noul nostru Entry. Vine cu ani de experiență și un click de mouse foarte zgomotos. Salută-l pe Discord și arată-i cum jucăm la -20°C.
text.hu: raduTNT csatlakozik a főcsapathoz, mint új Entry játékosunk. Évek tapasztalatával és nagyon hangos egérkattintással érkezik. Köszöntsd Discordon, és mutasd meg neki, hogyan játszunk -20°C-ban.

title.en: Viccash moves up to first substitute

text.en: After a strong run of practice matches, Viccash is now first in line to step in whenever one of the five needs a rest. Well deserved.
text.ro: După o serie puternică de meciuri de antrenament, Viccash este acum primul la rând când unul dintre cei cinci are nevoie de pauză. Meritat.
text.hu: Az erős edzőmeccsek után Viccash az első, aki beugrik, ha az öt játékos valamelyikének pihennie kell. Megérdemelt.

title.ro: stfandrei trece pe banca de rezerve

text.en: stfandrei steps back from the main five to make room for a new face. He stays with the squad as a substitute and will be back in the rotation soon.
text.ro: stfandrei se retrage din primii cinci pentru a face loc unei fețe noi. Rămâne în echipă ca rezervă și va reveni curând în rotație.
text.hu: stfandrei kilép az első ötből, hogy helyet adjon egy új arcnak. Cserejátékosként marad a csapatnál, és hamarosan visszatér a rotációba.
